title: Hazardous-Waste Fee on Maintenance Re-decision Lines — Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts
content:
For a maintenance re-decision line of a Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts contract, the hazardous-waste fee repaid follows the labor on the repair order. The fee and the labor lines are read from the Service Accounts and Repair Orders records.

| Hazardous-waste fee | Customer-pay labor on the repair order | Fee repaid |
|---|---|---|
| Charged | all on the repaired concern line | the whole fee |
| Charged | also on other concern lines | the fee times the repaired line's labor charge over all customer-pay labor charged on the repair order, rounded half up to the cent |
| Not charged | — | none |

The repaired concern line is the one carrying the repair order's diagnostic fee.

**Cases (hypothetical fee of 6.10).**
- An engine repair with all labor on the repaired line: 6.10.
- A transmission repair with 900.00 of the repair order's 1200.00 of customer-pay labor on the repaired line: 6.10 times 0.75, which is 4.575, rounded half up to 4.58.
- No fee: 0.00.
